name: Sint Maarten
summary: Sint Maarten taxes residents on worldwide income under a schedular system. Passive capital gains are exempt except on a substantial (5%+) shareholding (19.5%); dividends are taxed at the progressive rates up to 47.5% (including a 25% surtax), with credit for foreign tax. A pensioner's regulation lets eligible new residents pay 10% on foreign income (or progressive tax on deemed income of XCG 500,000). Inheritance and gift tax apply; the rates were not verified and are assumed to follow the former Netherlands Antilles table (2%-6% for children). No wealth tax and no real property tax.

regimes.name: Ordinary tax residence
regimes.description: Worldwide schedular income tax up to 47.5%; passive gains exempt; inheritance and gift tax for residents.
regimes.eligibility: Resident if the centre of existence is in Sint Maarten (Deloitte 2026). Dutch nationals have conditional admission rights; others need a residence permit.

capital_gains.summary: Capital gains of individuals who are not entrepreneurs (passive gains) are exempt, except gains on a substantial shareholding (5% or more), taxed at a special 19.5% rate. Entrepreneurs' gains are taxed at the progressive rates.

sources.title: Deloitte International Tax: Sint Maarten Highlights 2026

capital_gains.rate_basis: Deloitte Sint Maarten Highlights 2026: passive gains exempt unless 5%+ shareholding; 19.5% special rate for substantial share interest. private_business_sale assumes a 5%+ stake.
capital_gains.professional_trader: Gains in an individual's business are taxed at progressive rates up to 47.5%.
capital_gains.important_exceptions: Protective assessment on emigration for 5%+ shareholdings; 4% transfer tax on real estate purchases.

dividends.summary: Dividends are income from movable assets, taxed at progressive rates up to 47.5% (top band above XCG 161,540 in 2026, including the 25% surtax). A 19.5% rate applies to dividends from a substantial interest. Foreign tax is credited up to the Sint Maarten tax on that income. No dividend withholding tax.

sources.title: Deloitte International Tax: Sint Maarten Highlights 2026

dividends.rate_basis: Deloitte 2026 individual table: 47.5% (incl. 25% surtax) above XCG 161,540; credit for foreign tax limited to the local tax on that income.
dividends.withholding_outbound: No WHT on dividends, interest or royalties.
dividends.treaty_network: Four tax treaties (incl. the Tax Arrangement for the Kingdom) and 23 TIEAs.

sources.title: Deloitte International Tax: Sint Maarten Highlights 2026

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: No real property tax; 4% transfer tax on real estate purchases (buyer).

inheritance.summary: Deloitte 2026 confirms that inheritance tax and gift tax apply in Sint Maarten. Sint Maarten inherited the Netherlands Antilles Successiebelastingverordening 1908. Its current rates and exemptions were not found. The JSON assumes the descendant table that survives in Curacao's version of the same ordinance (2% to 50,000, 4% to 250,000, 6% above) with no exemption, which is a low-confidence placeholder.

sources.title: Deloitte International Tax: Sint Maarten Highlights 2026

inheritance.gift_tax: Gift tax applies (Deloitte); rates assumed equal to inheritance tax.
inheritance.domicile_rules: Under the shared Antillean ordinance the tax applies when the deceased or donor was resident (assumed).
open_questions: Placeholder: Sint Maarten's own rates were not found; the Curaçao table is shown for reference only and the metric is treated as missing.
Sint Maarten's own successiebelasting rates, exemptions for children and scope (resident deceased, worldwide) are not verified; the Curacao table and amendments since 2010 may differ.

regimes.name: Pensioner's regulation (10% on foreign income)
regimes.description: An eligible taxpayer may opt for a 10% flat rate on foreign income, or progressive tax on deemed foreign income of XCG 500,000 (Deloitte 2026). Designed to attract high-net-worth foreign individuals.
regimes.eligibility: Conditions not verified; in the sister regime in Curacao they include prior non-residence, minimum age and owning a home of a minimum value.
regimes.duration_note: No end date is mentioned in Deloitte's description; by analogy with the shared Antillean regime it applies for every year the conditions are met. Not verified against Sint Maarten law.

dividends.summary: Foreign dividends taxed at 10% flat under the pensioner's regulation; domestic dividends as standard.

cost_of_living.city: Dutch Sint Maarten (Point Blanche / Oyster Pond / Cole Bay / Madame Estate)

prime_rent_monthly.description: Median of the four houses/villas with 4-5 bedrooms in Century 21 St. Maarten's long-term rentals list (108 listings) on 15 Oct 2026: USD 3,500 (4 bed/3 bath villa, Great Bay Terraces, Point Blanche), 4,000 (4 bed/5 bath furnished house, Oyster Pond), 5,000 (four-bedroom 'Villa Aruba', Madame Estate, 'available for yearly rentals', per month), 9,000 (5 bed villa with pool, Chateau Diamante, Cole Bay). Excluded: a 4-bed condo at Dawn Beach (USD 4,000) and a St Johns Estate home listed as 4 bedrooms but described as 3 (USD 2,200). Including the Dawn Beach condo the median is USD 4,000. Thin sample; asking rents, listings undated. Sint Maarten Sotheby's and other agencies list only holiday villa rates.
